List.Name: Get topic runtime status
List.Description: Gets the runtime health of all distributed topic subscriptions, including subscribing, recovering, and failed states together with the most recent error information.

List.Name: Get all subscriptions
List.Description: Gets all EventBus subscription information, including local and distributed subscriptions.

Detail.Name: Get subscription details
Detail.Description: Gets detailed subscription information by subscription ID.

Statistics.Name: Get subscription statistics
Statistics.Description: Gets subscription statistics, including totals, state distribution, and scope distribution.

Activate.Name: Activate subscription
Activate.Description: Activates a pending or inactive subscription.

Deactivate.Name: Deactivate subscription
Deactivate.Description: Deactivates an active subscription without removing it.

TestBench.Title: Test a distributed event
TestBench.Scope: Publish and receive TestEventMessage on the default distributed bus.
TestBench.PublishHelp: Choose a topic and send a real message through this provider.
TestBench.AcceptanceHelp: A successful publish confirms provider acceptance. Check the receiver to see whether this listener received the message.
TestBench.ReceiveHelp: Listen on the same topic before publishing to observe receipts.
TestBench.EmptyHelp: Start the listener, then publish to its topic. Provider acceptance alone does not prove receipt.
TestBench.ListenerLifetime: This page owns its listener and attempts to stop it when you leave. If removal fails, the next visit recovers the same listener so you can retry Stop. Recent receipts remain in this browser circuit until cleared or the circuit ends.

RuntimeTest.Fanout: Route publication can reach every active subscriber on this topic, including other processes for a distributed route. The separate local delivery action targets only this handler.
RuntimeTest.ValidationHelp: Validation checks JSON deserialization against the registered event type.
RuntimeTest.AcceptanceHelp: Local success means dispatch completed. Distributed success means the transport accepted the event, without confirming consumer completion. Receipts below show only what this listener actually captured.
RuntimeTest.ReceiveHelp: An additional test listener receives events for this exact target.
RuntimeTest.EmptyHelp: Start listening before publishing. Only payloads actually received by this listener appear here.
RuntimeTest.ListenerLifetime: This listener belongs to the browser circuit and keeps running after this dialog closes. Stop it explicitly here or in the registry. Only a bounded set of recent payloads is retained in memory.
RuntimeTest.LocalDeliveryHelp: Deliver only to this selected handler in this process. This runs real handler, transaction and Inbox effects, without publishing to a broker or enabling automatic receipt. Each delivery gets a new message ID unless replay is selected.
RuntimeTest.ReplayMessage: Replay the previous message with its original ID and unchanged payload
RuntimeTest.LocalDeliveryCompleted: Local receive pipeline completed. Inbox may skip an already processed replay.

ChangeLedger.Title: Subscription changes
ChangeLedger.Scope: The latest {0} accepted subscription changes observed in this browser circuit, retained in memory. This is not durable host history.
ChangeLedger.FeedLoss: The live feed reported {0} lost notifications. These are separate from entries that aged out of the retained window and cannot be reconstructed here.
ChangeLedger.WindowTruncated: {0} earlier observed entries are outside the latest {1}-entry window. This is window retention, not feed loss.
ChangeLedger.Search: Search event types, topics, service keys, or subscription IDs
ChangeLedger.FilterScope: Filter counts describe the retained window. Newest observations first.
ChangeLedger.EmptyHelp: Observation starts when an EventBus workbench mounts. Existing registrations do not create past entries, and activity while no workbench is mounted is not captured.
ChangeLedger.NoMatchesHelp: Try another search or change type. Filters apply only to entries in this retained session window.
ChangeLedger.EvidenceHelp: Registration and reported topic runtime are independent states recorded with each observation. Inspect opens that frozen evidence, including removed subscriptions; it does not look up the current registry row.
